purpose: Public reconstruction contract for a source-isolated OpenCompass 0.5.1 vs 0.5.2 sensitivity test. This is not evidence of the DeMix authors' exact wrapper/runtime.

fixture_model.tokenizer_and_config_identity_rule: all tokenizer/config files must resolve from the exact same Hugging Face revision before execution; persist local file hashes in the execution receipt
fixture_model.device_intent: CPU/source-isolation first; no wrapper switch between anchors

source_reachability_audit.hf_wrapper: identical blob at both anchors, so wrapper implementation itself is removed as an A1 source confounder
source_reachability_audit.models_registry: 0.5.2 adds unrelated OpenAI rollout and TeleChat imports; HuggingFaceCausalLM import remains unchanged
source_reachability_audit.evaluator_registry: 0.5.2 adds PILLMEvaluator only; none of the nine frozen benchmark configs select it
source_reachability_audit.openicl_eval_rollout_branch: new 0.5.2 rollout aggregation path is unreachable for ordinary HuggingFaceCausalLM string predictions
source_reachability_audit.openicl_eval_dataset_postprocessor_chang: 0.5.2 forwards dataset_postprocessor kwargs whereas 0.5.1 passed only the sample. Of the nine configs, only GSM8K declares dataset_postprocessor and it supplies no kwargs beyond type, so this source change is behaviorally neutral for the frozen GSM8K config
source_reachability_audit.openicl_eval_judge_gpu_change: resource accounting only for judge-style evaluators; none of the nine frozen configs use that judge path
remaining_source_risks: import-time registry/dependency side effects from new modules imported by opencompass.datasets/__init__.py
shared task/evaluation infrastructure not yet proven byte-identical
dependency resolution and runtime library behavior
DeMix authors' actual wrapper/config remains unknown

execution_contract.phase_1: Under one exact Python 3.10 dependency lock, import both anchors and record import success plus package/file hashes before any benchmark run.
execution_contract.phase_2: Run identical raw inference for all nine frozen configs and persist per-sample/raw-result hashes before evaluation.
execution_contract.phase_3: Evaluate the seven non-code-execution benchmarks under the identical environment and compare result/summary/parser hashes.
execution_contract.phase_4: Run MBPP/HumanEval evaluators only inside an appropriate isolated code-execution sandbox; otherwise retain raw-inference comparison without claiming score identity.
execution_contract.human_eval_metric_scope: Standard frozen config requests k=[1,10,100]. A public DeMix reproduction may explicitly choose pass@1 for a deterministic reconstruction, but this must not be described as recovered author intent without an author result/config artifact.
execution_contract.success_condition: Same wrapper/model/tokenizer/datasets/dependencies and byte-identical raw outputs + parsed scores across anchors. Any difference must be localized before moving to wrapper or package-native sensitivity tracks.

next_action: Finish import-time added-registry audit, pin the exact shared dependency lock, then execute Track A1 with this fixture and persist environment/model/tokenizer/raw-output/result hashes.
